 1 Hr Rental = Cave Point & Back:
 Enough time to visit Cave Point with a short stop. 4.5 miles to Cave Point. Bike speed up to 20mph with pedal assist.

 2 Hr Rental = Cave Point :
 Enough time to loop Cave Point and Whitefish Bay Dunes with time to explore or enjoy your picnic. Total mileage ~8-10 miles

 A Cave Point Fat Tire E-bike Rental is a perfect way to explore Jacksonport, Cave Point, and Whitefish Bay Dunes without tiring yourself out during your vacation! You’ll primarily ride on backroads and bike trails. Cave Point is accessible by road, while we recommend utilizing one of the many bike trails in Whitefish Bay Dunes State Park (inside of state park, power is not permitted).

 What is an E-Bike?

An E-Bike is an electronic bicycle that has a pedal-assist feature. The pedal-assist means that less physical effort is required; so you can spend your time enjoying the views, not catching your breath.

Adjust the bike’s electric assistance to fit your preferences. It’s suitable both for people who want a good workout and for those that don’t want to expend much energy.

Easier than a segway and a whole lot cooler!
